# SYNTHETIC DATA

Everything in this directory is invented and written by hand for the recipe tests of Memini.

- Hearth (a chat server), Millnotes (a meeting note-taker) and Quillpost (a mail server) are
  fictional MCP servers; their tools, fields and ids are made up.
- No real server, workspace, channel, person, credential, token or key.

Keep it that way: a change to this directory adds invented content only (CLAUDE.md, "Never commit").
